# ISO/IEC 27001:2013/Cor 2:2015

Information technology — Security techniques — Information security management systems — Requirements — Technical Corrigendum 2

French title: Technologies de l'information — Techniques de sécurité — Systèmes de management de la sécurité de l'information — Exigences — Rectificatif technique 2

Status: Withdrawn, stage 95.99 Withdrawal of International Standard.
Type: Technical Corrigendum to a International Standard.
Edition 2, published 2015-11-12, 2 pages.
Languages: en, fr.
Committee: ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 27, Information security, cybersecurity and privacy protection.
ICS: 35.030 IT Security; 03.100.70 Management systems.
Replaced by: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (current).

## Other editions and drafts of ISO/IEC 27001

- ISO/IEC 27001:2005 (withdrawn, 2005-10-14)
- ISO/IEC 27001:2013 (withdrawn, 2013-09-25)
- ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (current, 2022-10-25)

Farzan Arena's own controls are mapped to this standard in docs/compliance/frameworks/iso27001.md (its control identifiers and names); the grc knowledge pack holds the frameworks whose texts may be shared (NIST's, the EU AI Act's).

ISO's page of it: https://www.iso.org/standard/69378.html
